source: Google AI Studio rate-limit page and Groq console, read by Tanuj on 2026-10-08. The field count=per_input means every input of a batch call counts as one request (measured 2026-10-08: a batch of 10 inputs moved Google AI Studio's requests-per-day by 10). These are QUOTA numbers, not model choices: which model a task uses is decided only by the AI_*_MODEL variables. The numbers change; override them with AI_MODEL_LIMITS (see .env.example) instead of editing code.
